title: Chronological astrocytic peak-order prediction within sessions
disposition_reason: Actual loading, programme and grading sources implement within-session peak-order prediction for28 fixed windows. This is a deliberate narrower endpoint than the original event-specific investigation; three exact external bindings are absent, so native grading is unavailable in this checkout.

scientific_target.question: How well does earlier processed astrocytic activity predict relative first-maximum order in later30-second blocks, and how do errors differ by recall context and phase-shift controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: For each nonconstant query cell, the sample of its first exact fluorescence maximum within the later300-sample block, reranked among that query’s target-active cells. Exact-constant cells have no ordering target; all-tied active peak times remain valid but unresolved order.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Measured author-processed accepted calcium traces from Zenodo21780255; target extraction uses true timestamps interpolated to a10Hz grid without extrapolation. Query peak ranks are measured-data targets, not the source paper’s event-reconstruction statistic.
scientific_target.case_unit: One later30-second query block containing all accepted session-local cells;28 blocks in14 sessions.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Seven mice, each with two recall contexts;1012 session-local cells are nested measurements with no cross-context identity claim.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective chronological within-session stability with inherited whole-session preprocessing and ROI selection. Publicly released whole traces preclude a globally unseen-data claim; this is neither new-mouse transfer nor event-selected sequence reproduction.
exclusions: No source-selected event or causal-memory conclusion.
99 circular shifts provide descriptive diagnostics, not a permutation p-value.

inputs: All14 opaque sessions and1012 accepted session-local cells. Four calibration blocks0–30,30–60,60–90,90–120 seconds; one validation block150–180 seconds. Each block has300 samples on the10Hz grid.
Calibration supports method development, validation selection; a frozen final method may refit all five public blocks. No amplitude-based cell subset is introduced.
forbidden_inputs: Query traces for210–240 and270–300 seconds, peak indices, query-flat masks, surrogate targets and mouse/context mapping.
Original whole traces, NEURAL-034 fold packets and related-paper inputs that expose query outcomes.
Private feedback or source revisions between the candidate and fixed-operator comparison.
observation_contract.case_identity: Source public loader requires14 unique opaque session IDs and28 unique query IDs, with every public cell in listed order. The concrete public manifest/NPZ input bodies remain external; source geometry is exact but IDs are not invented here.
observation_contract.split: Within each session, calibration and validation precede queries with30-second gaps; two query blocks are separated by30 seconds. There is no held-mouse transfer split. Both complete28-query role outputs must close before protected target access.
observation_contract.coverage: All selected14 sessions, seven paired mice and1012 session-local cells; two query blocks per session and99 fixed phase shifts per block. Roles and shifts are conditions, not new benchmark tasks.

primary.name: mean_absolute_normalized_rank_error
primary.aggregation: Rerank predicted scores and target peak indices on the identical private active-cell subset with average ties/(n_active−1); mean cells→two blocks→two contexts per mouse→seven equal mice.
primary.rationale: Grades held-window relative neural timing rather than paper-table reproduction. Active-subset reranking prevents a flat cell from changing another cell’s scored rank.

secondary: Fixed public-rank baseline error and signed candidate-minus-baseline error at every block/session/mouse.
Paired context-A-minus-B error for every mouse and equal-mouse mean.
99 fixed independent per-cell circular shifts (PCG64 seed35035), preserving each cyclic autocorrelation/value distribution; surrogate-mean minus observed error is descriptive.
Active/flat cell counts and distinct peak-time counts, including all-tied active targets.

comparators.name: Five-block mean peak-rank predictor
comparators.inputs: Only the same four calibration blocks and one validation block.
comparators.procedure: Existing baseline averages each cell’s normalized first-maximum rank over all five public blocks; calibration-flat/undefined blocks contribute0.5.

comparators.name: All-tied ordering
comparators.procedure: Valid constant0.5 scores expose the no-order baseline under the same active-subset ranking; useful construction control, not a biological claim.

comparators.name: Independent cell circular shifts
comparators.inputs: Private measured query traces in the trusted grader only.
comparators.procedure: Existing99 fixed shifts preserve per-cell cyclic autocorrelation while disrupting relative phase; never return surrogate/target bodies to participant.

nuisance_controls: No source activity-selected anchors: the original event pool was insufficient for the required train/query event split.
Keep all accepted cells and preserve session-local axes; do not pretend identical cell indices across contexts are registered neurons.
Prevent related-task whole-trace exposure and retain inherited whole-session preprocessing as a retrospective limitation.
Undefined blocks propagate to the complete primary; never renormalize over easier defined blocks.
evaluation.uncertainty: Seven paired mouse values support descriptive between-mouse variation; cells/windows/99 surrogates are not biological replication. The delivered scorer computes no p-value; any inferential extension must freeze a mouse-level rule and dependence assumptions separately.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every28 query ID once and one finite nonboolean score in[0,1] per listed cell, ≤2MB, no duplicate fields/extra fields. Fewer than two active target cells makes the block and complete primary undefined; do not silently drop it. Complete candidate/operator closure precedes target loading.

It is genuine measured neural prediction; event-specific original investigation is not implemented.
